link.description: The embedded resource — an `hm://` URL, optionally pinned to a version, block or text range.

childrenType.description: How this block lays out its children — a children type such as `Unordered` or `Grid`.

columnCount.description: Number of columns the children occupy when `childrenType` is `Grid`.

view.description: How the target renders: its content, a card, its comments or a plain link.

description: An embed of another Hypermedia document, block or text range, shown in place by `hm://` link.
